raw_text: Bharati bahriya ka jahaaz Arabian Sea mein doob gaya. Ye video poori duniya mein viral ho rahi hai. Indian Navy kuch bhi kahay, video saboot hai. Pakistan ka samundar par qabza mazboot hai. Is video ko zyada se zyada share karein.
clean_text: Urdu-language account claims Indian Navy ship sank in Arabian Sea. Video being shared widely. Calls for further sharing of footage.
